column1: # iw8_scriptables.tsv: stock Replay 1.20 scriptable definitions (tools/build_scriptable_catalog.py, docs/research/86).
# always_loaded=1: in a zone every multiplayer match has loaded (common_core_mp, common_base_mp, common_mp, global_core_mp): a map can place it by name.
# instance_dynent / sparse_occluder / collision_flags / physics_dynents: the dynamic entities one instance gets;
# source=observed: read from stock map instances; derived: a guess (no stock map places it, and the rule for
# instance_dynent is not known). physics_limit / physics_limit_detail: the definition counts in the main /
# detailed scriptable physics limits of a map (flag bits 13+14 / 13+15; the rule gives the stored limits of all 21
# exported stock maps, research 89). verified=1: observed, so every number is known. The editor builds a verified definition:
# by name when always_loaded, else (with Real stock scripted objects on) carried from its first mp_ zone.
